## Activity

During November 2018, River Outreach completed 80 captures. This activity provides the basis for the operational review for the month. The recorded volume reflects all captures completed at the site during the reporting period. No additional activity is included in this report.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 9 captures that could not be graded. The ungradable rate was 11.2. These captures were excluded from grading because the images did not meet the requirements for a reliable assessment. The result is noted for monitoring in future reporting periods. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

Grading identified 3 referable results. The median lag between capture and completion of grading was 6. This measure indicates the typical time taken for a result to progress from image capture to grading during November 2018. The grading findings and image-quality result should be considered together when reviewing site performance. Further monitoring will support assessment of whether the ungradable rate and grading turnaround remain consistent at River Outreach.
